list_metadata.title: Joplin Manufacturer IMD Comparative Ranked List
list_metadata.scope: Comparative ranking of only the three candidates whose Version 1.1 dossiers were completed and committed after the governed 10-organization Joplin-region discovery run.
list_metadata.lookback: 10 years, inherited from the governed discovery run
exclusions: No reopening or broadening of the 10-organization discovery universe
No named-person research or contact enrichment
No new evidence admitted during comparative ranking
limitations: Ranking compares only the three completed dossiers; it is not an absolute market score.
Public evidence may omit private corrective actions, controls, recurrence, evidence access, sponsor authority, budget, and willingness.
Protein Solutions has only partial public support for corrective action and post-action recurrence.
National Manufacturing Group's 2026 OSHA inspections remain open and cannot be treated as repeat LOTO findings.
Dyno Nobel's strongest later evidence favors successful correction/closure of the 2020 environmental matter.

strong_gates: Current Meaningful Operating Boundary Gate = PASS
Public evidence rich enough for defensible chronology
Economic fit and sponsor role at least plausible
No unresolved contradiction defeats the core pattern
tiering_method.disclaimer: Ranks compare only candidates within this fixed research universe and date. They are not absolute market scores, diagnoses, accusations, or outreach authorization.

prospects.relevant_boundary: 3800 E 32nd Street Joplin production facility and odor-mitigation / complaint-response controls
prospects.candidate_problem: odor-control complaint response, corrective-action verification, and learning
prospects.strongest_public_signal: Company acknowledgment and stated odor controls are followed by official Missouri DNR odor concerns in 2024 and 2025 at a currently operating Joplin boundary.
prospects.strongest_counterevidence: The 2025 DNR investigation observed no odor-rule violation, and later odor concerns do not establish verified plant-caused post-correction recurrence.
prospects.sponsor_role: partial; plant manager, environmental/EHS leader, or operations leader role only; no named person
prospects.urgency_trigger: partial; recent official odor concerns, but no verified post-correction violation
decisive_unknowns: Exact corrective actions and engineering/maintenance changes tied to the historical odor lineage
Whether internal complaint/monitoring records show comparable recurrence after those actions
Sponsor authority, evidence access, budget, and willingness
prospects.why_ranked_here: Only candidate in the completed set with a Moderate tier. It has the most complete public P-A-C-R signal and a supported current boundary, while still preserving material counterevidence and uncertainty.
prospects.human_review_status: required before selection or contact; pending

prospects.relevant_boundary: 1000 South Schifferdecker Joplin manufacturing operation and LOTO/energy-control program
prospects.candidate_problem: hazardous-energy-control procedure, periodic review, corrective-action verification, and learning
prospects.strongest_public_signal: Primary OSHA records document specific serious LOTO deficiencies and completed February 2025 abatements at a current same-site manufacturing boundary.
prospects.strongest_counterevidence: The two 2026 same-site OSHA complaint inspections remain open and do not establish comparable post-abatement LOTO recurrence.
prospects.sponsor_role: partial; plant EHS/safety leader, operations leader, or plant manager role only; no named person
prospects.urgency_trigger: partial; two current 2026 OSHA complaint inspections, without proven hazard comparability
decisive_unknowns: Whether either 2026 OSHA matter involves hazardous-energy control
Effectiveness of the 2025 LOTO abatements across affected/comparable equipment
Current LOTO procedure, periodic-inspection, training, CAPA and audit records
Sponsor authority, evidence access, budget, and willingness
prospects.why_ranked_here: Ranks above Dyno Nobel within Weak because it has a discrete current LOTO boundary, primary-source corrective-action evidence, and a more current unresolved attention signal. The absence of supported post-abatement recurrence prevents Moderate or Strong.

prospects.relevant_boundary: Carthage plant environmental management, wastewater, stormwater, hazardous-waste and corrective-control systems
prospects.candidate_problem: historical environmental corrective-action learning and verification
prospects.strongest_public_signal: EPA and other public records provide a rich chronology of the 2020 environmental matter and extensive required corrective measures at a currently operating Carthage plant.
prospects.strongest_counterevidence: Later evidence favors successful correction and closure: completion of remaining consent-decree requirements, ISO 14001 audit performance, and 2025 consent-decree termination; later OSHA events are separate lineages.
prospects.sponsor_role: partial; plant EHS/environmental leader, site manager, or environmental compliance leader role only; no named person
decisive_unknowns: Whether a different current recurring environmental/process-learning problem exists after decree closure
Post-closure internal ISO/CAPA/effectiveness and permit-monitoring evidence
Sponsor authority, evidence access, budget, and willingness
prospects.why_ranked_here: Ranks third because the strongest disconfirming evidence supports successful correction/closure of the candidate environmental problem and no current comparable recurrence was established. Rich evidence and a current boundary cannot compensate for that missing recurrence/urgency.
prospects.human_review_status: do not prioritize absent new current problem evidence; pending

source_categories_not_available: Named sponsor authority or budget evidence
For open 2026 OSHA matters, final citation/disposition evidence

comparative_decision.selection_status: No pilot prospect selected. Human qualification review is required before selection or contact.

qualification_priority: Human-review Protein Solutions first against the decisive unknowns in dossier JMP-PS.
If Protein Solutions fails human qualification, consider National Manufacturing Group / Able Composites as a conditional backup, especially if comparable 2026 OSHA information becomes available.
additional_research: Do not reopen broad public prospecting.
Only obtain evidence necessary to resolve decisive human-qualification questions for the ranked candidates.
do_not_advance: Do not select or contact Dyno Nobel from the current public dossier unless new current problem evidence materially changes the Weak classification.
Do not treat open OSHA inspections as violations or recurrence.
Do not convert these rankings into numerical scores.

decision_options: select Protein Solutions for authorization-package completion
downgrade/hold Protein Solutions and review National Manufacturing Group as backup
